minnow_lift_the_leaves_out_of_the_school: Leaves out. The school wheeled past like I'd done them a favour.
Twelve leaves, one reed. A very small victory.
minnow_shoo_the_stray_back_to_the_shoal: Back with the others. It clearly has no plans.
Herded a fish one inch. Sheepdog duck.
minnow_feed_crumbs_one_at_a_time: Crumb in, crumb gone. Seven mouths, one bill.
Fed a school with a bill. Tiny logistics, huge ego.
minnow_ribbon_the_school_behind_a_wingti: Ribboned a school. It wore me like a scarf.
A figure of eight, drawn by a duck, finished by a hundred fish.
minnow_dangle_a_toe_for_the_nibblers: They nibble. I giggle. Neither party admits anything.
A toe is the best flake. Said the school.
minnow_chase_the_school_down_the_rim: Never caught one. They move as one thought, a mean one.
Chased silver. Got wet air. Fine day.
minnow_count_the_school_by_sixes: Eleven. Twenty. Nineteen. It will not hold still for a number.
Counted sixes, lost the sixth, started the whole job over.
minnow_bow_to_the_school_in_unison: Bowed three times. The school bowed once, for all of them.
Honoured a crowd of fish. I deserve a medal. A flake.
minnow_argue_with_a_whole_school: Fifty of them, one of me. Naturally I won.
It turned as one and left. Argument ended by exit.
minnow_shout_the_count_at_the_cattails: Counted out loud. The school inflated its own numbers.
Told the cattails: more fish than reeds. They did not argue.
minnow_flinch_when_the_school_leaps_at_h: A hundred minnows. One duck. Immediate retreat.
They flicked. I flew. Very efficient, both sides.
minnow_herd_the_school_from_both_ends: Ball formed. Both ends took credit. Minnows took a vote.
Two ducks, one school. It chose the middle.
minnow_tally_the_school_with_a_friend: Twenty. Forty. Never the same fish twice. Fine.
Two counters, one school, forty-one answers. Math is fluid.
